verdict.rationale: Riveter's own API lets developers pull run results out programmatically. There is a /runs/{id}/result endpoint, and webhooks POST the full results to your URL, so scraped data can be extracted. Nothing documents exporting job or enrichment configurations, a portable export format, or migration tooling. Missing for 10: export of job/enrichment/schedule configurations, a documented portable export format (e.g. CSV/JSON bulk export), migration or anti-lock-in guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my scraped data and job configurations in a portable format to migrate to another provider without lock-in

citations.quote: Riveter POSTs the full results to your URL when it finishes
